proposal.summary: A path traversal vulnerability in LimeSurvey 4.1.11+ allows an attacker to download arbitrary files via the File Manager 'path' parameter; the file may be deleted after download if the web service account has permissions, enabling denial of service against critical files.
proposal.cwe_quote: A path traversal vulnerability exists within the "File Manager" functionality of LimeSurvey that allows an attacker to download arbitrary files.

S.quote: A path traversal vulnerability exists within the "File Manager" functionality of LimeSurvey that allows an attacker to download arbitrary files.

C.quote: A path traversal vulnerability exists within the "File Manager" functionality of LimeSurvey that allows an attacker to download arbitrary files.

A.quote: The file manager functionality will also delete the file after it is downloaded (if the web service account has permissions to do so), allowing an attacker to cause a denial of service by specifying a critical LimeSurvey configuration file.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce the issue and determine whether authentication is required; if confirmed, block path traversal by canonicalizing and validating the 'path' parameter (disallow '..' segments and restrict file access to permitted directories) and audit/remove any ability for the web service account to delete critical configuration files.
